# Zidedele Logistics Solutions

> Richards Bay-based logistics company offering road transport, A-grade warehousing, materials handling, cargo handling and security, machinery hire and fuel delivery. Over 30 years of forest-products logistics experience, Level 1 B-BBEE, 5-Star safety grading since 2017, member of the Greenmile Group of Companies.

- Address: 39 Kabelkring, Alton, Richards Bay, 3900, KwaZulu-Natal, South Africa
- Phone: +27 35 797 4025
- Email: info@zidedele.co.za
